# Step 2.77: the bin and activity log screens (builders' note)

**Where it stands.** Part 1 (the bin screen) and part 2 (the activity log screen) are built and tested. Left: the carry-overs listed at the end.

**Part 1, the bin** (`apps/web/src/features/bin-area/`, route `/[league]/admin/settings/bin`): teams, people and games with "Bring it back", reached from Teams, Schedule and the notice after a removal; S-83, S-84. Details on bin lines (`packages/core/src/modules/leagues/bin.ts`, `packages/database/src/queries/list-binned.ts`); the stand-in's bin (`apps/web/src/server/stand-in-world-bin.ts`). Test: `tests/browser/bin-screen-test.mjs`.

**Part 2 stock-take (the activity log).**

- Read already there: `access.list_activity` (newest first, `before` only, no filters) and the database's `listActivityEntries`; the Admins page shows its ten latest access changes.
- The made-up world recorded entries without id or time and listed none; the Admins page's stand-in reads a shell that lists none.
- Missing: filters (who, kind, dates), a newer page, a screen of its own, the season status in its entry, the way from a removal to the bin.

**Part 2, built**

- Core: `access/activity-search.ts` (kinds from command names, `pageOfActivity` for the made-up stores), `access/queries/search-activity.ts` + test (owner and league admins; by actor, kind, from/until; `before` or `after`; says where older and newer pages start). The log port's `list` takes an optional search (no new port). `leagues.update_season` now keeps `status` in its entry.
- Database: `list-activity-entries.ts` filters in SQL; test in `stores/access-commands.test.ts` (two leagues); isolation case; role-matrix row.
- Stand-in: `stand-in-world.ts` keeps entries with id and time and pages them.
- Web: `features/access-area/activity-log-page.tsx`, `activity-log-view.ts` + test; route `app/[league]/admin/settings/activity/page.tsx`; "See the whole activity log" on Admins. Pickers (who, what) in the FilterToolbar, a days form, Older/Newer, 20 a page. Messages `adminAccess.log.*`; styles in `staff-pages.css`; a picture `admin-settings-activity` in `scripts/shots.mjs`.
- Pins: page-step rows in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` (owner, admin 200; scheduler, coach, stranger, scorekeeper, registrar 403); the route in `harmful-text-test.mjs`; `access.search_activity` listed as a read. The bin and the log are pages of League settings, not areas, so neither pinned list (unreleased page, `adminPlaceholders`) names them: nothing to change there (both tests run).
- Small: the team page's roster marks a person in the bin "(not on the league list: in the bin)" (S-84), unit-tested, not in a browser test.

**Done test** `tests/browser/activity-log-test.mjs`: 390 wide, scripts off by taps from the admin menu: 18 teams for a second page, a team removed, the season hidden and shown again; the log shows all with who and when, the season's entries say hidden then shown, the removal leads to the bin, the restore shows first; Older/Newer; filter by kind, by who, by days (empty says so); scripts on, a kind applies at once; coach and scorekeeper refused (403).

**Decisions**: T-306 (pending file, Agreed (delegated)); spec P4 §6 corrected. No product question needed a new S- number.

**Checks run**: `npm run check` passed; typecheck passed; prettier clean. `activity-log-test.mjs` 26 checks, 0 failed; `bin-screen-test.mjs` 21, 0 failed; `harmful-text-test.mjs` 1868 passed; `nothing-unfinished-test.mjs` 2365 passed; `npm run test:web` 251 passed. - Divisions, venues and courts are not on the bin screen; they keep their own put-back notices.
- The Admins page's own "Latest changes" still reads the stand-in's shell (empty there); the database is right.

- The stand-in keeps no time of removal in the bin (it uses the first time the bin is read).
